consequence.statement: The KVStore subsystem in the Cilium status API response changes from reporting OK state with Disabled message to reporting Disabled state; clients parsing the state field will see different values.

original.statement: The Cilium status API now reports the KVStore subsystem with Disabled state instead of OK state with Disabled message.

decision.reason: [ev-e6b268264713] says only that when the KVStore is disabled, the status API now reports it with a `Disabled` state instead of an `OK` state with a `Disabled` message. It doesn't say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. The change is in the reported value, so behavior-change (review) fits. The proposed statement says that clients reading the state field will see a different value, which matches the evidence without claiming any mandatory work. The evidence doesn't give a severity, so the proposed "medium" is a judgement call that the evidence doesn't contradict.
